sources.title: lair-nyu/yor_icl_pi0_fast_easy_pnp_v2_sanity15k_annealing · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: FAST-tokenized analogue of yor_icl_pi05_easy_pnp_v2, run on the same small 4-task subset to validate the FAST backend/data pipeline ahead of the expanded pi0-FAST run (yor_icl_pi0_fast_expanded). decay_steps matched to num_train_steps (same annealing fix as sanity15k_annealing).

sources.title: lair-nyu/yor_icl_fast_victr_vision_expanded_full · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: openpi TrainConfig: yor_icl_fast_victr_vision_expanded Checkpoint step: 15000 Contents: params/ (deployable policy weights) + assets/ (norm stats etc.) only -- train_state/ (optimizer state, needed only to resume this exact training run) is NOT included. Trained with openpi (pi0.5 backbone) on the icl-dataset. First publish of this repo.

sources.title: GitHub - Spirit-AI-Team/PI_Official
sources.snippet: the π₀ model, a flow-based diffusion vision-language-action model (VLA) the π₀-FAST model, an autoregressive VLA, based on the FAST action tokenizer. sources.title: OpenPI - Open Source Vision-Language-Action Model Library
sources.snippet: OpenPI Open Source Vision-Language-Action Model Library for Robotics Developed by the Physical Intelligence team, OpenPI hosts open-source VLA models pre-trained on 10k+ hours of robot data, enabling researchers and practitioners to fine-tune and deploy robotic manipulation capabilities across diverse platforms.

sources.title: GitHub - Physical-Intelligence/openpi
sources.snippet: openpi holds open-source models and packages for robotics, published by the Physical Intelligence team. Currently, this repo contains three types of models: the π₀ model, a flow-based vision-language-action model (VLA). the π₀-FAST model, an autoregressive VLA, based on the FAST action tokenizer. the π₀.₅ model, an upgraded version of π₀ with better open-world generalization ...
